semantics.definition: The base of the world: 21 base tiles across and 600 m long, a tile on every section and an astroid wherever four tiles meet. Things that stand by themselves are placed on it. Your words, 23 Nov.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one base platform every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be the ground of the world, on which other elements are placed.
